name: Degarashi
source: Fandisc for Imouto ni! Sukumizu Kisetara Nugasanai! distributed at Comiket 73. Contains 3 omake stories for Mamiya Sukuru, Suzuhara Keiko, and Aizawa Moyu; also contains various wallpapers.
translation: 为我的粉丝光盘！Sukumizu Kisetara Nugasanai！在Comiket 73上发行。包含间宫作久留、铃原惠子、相泽茉由的3个omake故事；还包含各种壁纸。
